At time of inspection it was determined that child care service failed to ensure staff received required training within time frames and/or failed to maintain training records.
All teachers have Not received training in infectious disease control and reporting.
Training in SIDS, Shaken Baby Syndrome and Safe Sleep practices Not provided to staff

At time of inspection it was determined that child care service allows staff to perform their duties that are Not healthy or are incapable of carrying out their duties. Staff medical clearances are Not maintained by child care service.
Child care service fails to conduct and document daily health assessment of incoming children. Individual Not trained to identify disease.

inspections.violation_description: At time of inspection child care service unable to document that all children enrolled have had an age appropriate medical evaluation.

violations.description: At time of inspection child care service unable to document that all children enrolled have had an age appropriate medical evaluation.

Staff and volunteers obtain documentation showing immunization with 2 doses measles/mumps, 1 dose rubella, 2 doses varicella and 1 dose Tdap. Medical exemptions only. History of measles, mumps or rubella shall Not replace MMR vaccine except in presence of MMR varicella antibodies.

When children over 12 months of age are mixed in contiguous groups ratio is based on predominant age in group
Permittee/applicant failed to submit a written safety plan; written safety plan is Not approved; staff Not trained, drilled in plan; training, drills Not evaluated; plan Not maintained and updated.
At the time of inspection child care service failed to maintain a minimum of 30 square feet of space per child.
